US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Formaldehyde, also called methanal, is the simplest aldehyde. It is a small reactive compound distinct from the larger resins and polymers made using it. The historical entry records a preservative classification. FDA describes a narrow processing context in which it preserves certain dimethylpolysiloxane-containing defoaming preparations. That provision does not establish general addition of formaldehyde to finished foods.
